name: Launcher - unit_track_sequencer_20261029
purpose: Launch ONE separate Reasonix session that executes the 18 unit-track re-verifications sequentially (POOL_SIZE=1 by design); resume-safe via progress.jsonl
launcher_kind: single-session sequential (deliberately NOT the fleet rolling pool - see deliberation/candidate_b_parallel_pool_across_sessions.md)
operator_actions_required: start one fresh Reasonix session (separate chat/session) against this repo
paste the LAUNCH-PROMPT.md body as the session's task
wait for the session to commit sequencer_verdict.md + progress.jsonl (or a partial verdict if it paused mid-run)
relaunch and re-paste the same prompt to resume from progress.jsonl's last row if a pause happened
safeguards: session must not modify js/**, manifest.json, or any test file (AC-4 aborts on any)
session must commit only the two expected artifacts with explicit paths
verification-only: a RED certificate is reported, never patched
